title: A nonlinear time-dependent energy propagates every homogeneous charge-graph tier

graph_energy.lifted_equation: For integer n>=0, psi_n=Q^n u satisfies psi_n''+(Omega^2+lambda s(t))psi_n=0 because Q commutes with Omega and the scalar radial multiplier.
graph_energy.positivity: F_n>=1/2||Q^n u'||^2+(m^2/2)||Q^n u||^2 and also controls ||Q^(n+1)u|| when mu>0.
graph_energy.gronwall: |F_n'|<=(4 lambda H_0/m^3)F_n, hence F_n(t)<=F_n(0)exp(4 lambda H_0|t|/m^3).
graph_energy.cutoff_uniformity: The estimate is identical for every spectral cutoff P_N and contains no ||Q_N|| factor.
graph_energy.outside_rigidity_class: F_n is nonlinear and time dependent through the actual solution coefficient s(t); K1406 classifies only time-independent quadratic spectral reweightings.
graph_energy.boundary: The estimate is global on K1409's invariant manifold but does not control the electric-current and spatially dependent coefficient defects of the full PDE.
